Trusted origins bypass SvelteKit's origin check failed.
  Why: A csrf.trustedOrigins entry of "*" turns off SvelteKit's Origin check on every route, and an entry of "null" admits every POST from an opaque origin, which any attacker can produce from a sandboxed iframe. cairn's admin keeps its double-submit token, but the site's forms have no Origin check at all. SameSite=Lax stops a cross-site post but not one from a sibling subdomain.
  Fix: Remove the "*" and "null" entries from csrf.trustedOrigins in the Vite config. List only the exact origins that must post to the site, since each one also widens SvelteKit's check on /admin.
  Docs: https://cairn.pub/docs/admin/is-it-working#keep-sveltekits-origin-check-on

9 passed, 1 failed, 2 skipped, 0 info, 0 unchecked
